question: Is any part of the product delivered in a browser (web app, PWA, marketing site with forms)?
Does the product expose network endpoints (REST/GraphQL/RPC, server routes, server actions)?
Do users or services sign in or present credentials?
Can users sign in with Google, Apple, Microsoft or another OAuth/OIDC provider?
Can anyone on the internet create an account (including guest or anonymous accounts) without an invitation?
Does data belong to different users, teams, organizations or clients that must not see each other's data?
Can users or external systems upload files?
Is user or business data stored in managed databases or object storage?
Does the product call ML, LLM, vision, speech or generative models?
Does any AI request send data to a provider outside your own infrastructure (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, a gateway)?
Does the product retrieve documents or records and place them into model context?
Are embeddings of user or business data stored in a vector index?
Can a model call tools, APIs, browsers or code, or change data, on its own?
Can a single request cost real money or quota (model calls, OCR, transcoding, GPU, paid APIs)?
Does the server fetch URLs or call hosts that a user, document or model can influence?
Does the product receive inbound webhooks or callbacks from other services?
Can users publish content that other users see (posts, comments, shared pages, profiles)?
Does the product handle personal, confidential, regulated, financial, health, student, client or proprietary data?
Could users or data subjects be under 18 (or under 13 for COPPA)?
Does the product accept payments or handle payment data?
Is there a privileged operator, admin or support interface?
Does the product connect to external SaaS or provider APIs on a user's behalf?
Are there separate workers, microservices, local services, queue consumers or retrieval servers?
